title: Nexus / Cost and Tools
description: Per-tool call volume and per-model token spend (docs/build-phases.md Phase 17, task 17.9) — the breakdown the Golden Signals board's own tenant-wide aggregates (cache-read rate, cost-ceiling breach rate) don't show. Tool counts come from events.tool_id (structural, never the encrypted payload); model spend comes from cost_records, the same reconciled truth internal/cost.Reconcile writes (README pattern #37).

panels.title: Tool call volume by tool
panels.description: tool_use events per tool_id (events.tool_id) — a snapshot of everything recorded so far, not a rate; watch for one tool dominating a run's tool budget or a tool that never gets called at all.

panels.title: Input tokens per model, by cache class
panels.description: internal/cost.Reconcile's own per-class split (uncached / cache_read / cache_write) — the same three classes the Golden Signals board's cache-read-rate panel sums tenant-wide, broken out per routed model instead.

panels.title: Reconciled cost per model
panels.description: cost_records.minor_units, converted to major currency units at this one exposition boundary (cmd/nexusd/main.go's handleMetrics) — internal/cost itself never computes with float64 (task 4.1's package-wide ban). See the currency label; this demo seeds every tenant with the same USD price book (task 4.3).
